sn45.31:1.1: Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || Tatravoca || || Micchāpaṭipattiñca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sammāpaṭipattiñca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamā ca bhikkhave micchāpaṭipatti || || Seyyathīdaṃ || micchādiṭṭhi || la [pe] || micchāsamādhi || || Ayam vuccati bhikkhave micchāpaṭipatti || || Katamā ca bhikkhave sammāpaṭipatti || || Seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || la [pe] || sammāsamādhi || || Ayam vuccati bhikkhave sammāpaṭipattī ti || || 1.2.
